subject: VP Platform candidate — counteroffer and sign-on/equity request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: VP Platform candidate — counteroffer and sign-on/equity request

Hi team,

Quick context: Evan Torres (finalist for VP, Platform) received a verbal counteroffer from his current employer today. Recruiter confirms they want a faster turnaround and a stronger sign-on to stay. Because this is a senior strategic hire owning infra + model-serving roadmap, I recommend we make a one-time exception to the published band.

Summary of current ask:
- Base offer band target: $300k (role band midpoint)
- Candidate counteroffer triggers: asking for $360k total cash + 0.8% refresh
- Our initial offer on file: $320k total cash + 0.5% equity
- Candidate asking for an additional $40k sign-on (one-time) and an additional 0.25% equity refresh

Why I recommend exception:
- Role is mission-critical: platform reliability and LLM infra expertise are scarce in market.
- Candidate has competing offers and an internal buy-back in-flight.
- Risk of losing this hire would push timeline for key platform initiatives ~6 months.

Request: approval to exceed band for a one-time sign-on of $40,000 (paid as cash sign-on) AND a one-time equity refresh of 0.25% (time-based RSU refresh, 4-year vesting) to be documented in offer letter. This would bring the package to $360k total cash (base + sign-on) and 0.75% total equity initial + refresh.

Attachments: resume_evan_torres.pdf (candidate CV)

Please respond with any redlines. If we approve, I will route the final offer to recruiting and legal to prepare the DocuSign packet. Given timeline risk, a same-day response would be ideal.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Talent Partners | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: VP Platform candidate — counteroffer and sign-on/equity request

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick summary. A couple of asks before I can sign off:

1) Can you confirm the budget owner and whether this increment sits inside headcount OPEX for Q2 or is a special T&E (one-time sign-on) charged to hiring manager discretionary? We need GL coding.
2) Please model 3-year cash and equity dilution impact (rough numbers) and whether this will set a precedent for other senior infra hires this quarter.
3) If we approve, I want the comp-approval memo to call out that this is a one-time exception tied explicitly to retention risk; include fallback language if candidate leaves within 12 months (clawback).

Tentative: I can approve up to $30k sign-on one-time today pending the memo and budget approval. Anything over that needs Exec sponsor sign-off.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

Team —

I reviewed the notes and had a quick conversation with the hiring manager (Rafa Mendes). Given the strategic nature and the near-term delivery risk, I am comfortable approving an exception with clear limits and documentation. Conditions below:

- Approved one-time sign-on: $40,000 (gross, lump-sum)
- Approved equity refresh: 0.25% one-time RSU grant (4-year vesting, standard cliffs)
- Requirement: Manager to confirm budget charge (product/platform headcount pool) and acknowledge the exception in Greenhouse record GH-12345
- Clawback: If employee exits within 12 months, 100% of the sign-on will be subject to prorated clawback as per standard policy. Equity follows standard repurchase provisions.
- Offer must use the 'Exception Offer' template and include language that this is a one-time exception approved by Head of Talent and Finance.

Attaching comp-approval-memo.pdf with the formal language. Once Aditya confirms GL coding, Legal (Monica) will prepare the DocuSign packet.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks — legal is fine with the exception in principle. A few practical notes we need to include in the offer packet:

- No tax gross-up for the sign-on; sign-on treated as supplemental wages and taxed accordingly.
- Clawback mechanics: HR to include repayment schedule and deduction authorization if the employee leaves within 12 months.
- Equity refresh: ensure grant is subject to standard RF vesting schedule and subject to Redwood equity plan and board approval (include a line that grant is contingent on board approval).
- IP/NDAs: Use standard VP-level IP assignment + confidentiality + garden-leave clauses. Do not modify without Legal review.

If recruiting routes the draft offer to me via DocuSign, I will do an expedited review.

Monica Patel
General Counsel | Redwood Inference

- Cash: $360,000 total cash (base + one-time sign-on $40,000)
- Equity: initial grant + one-time refresh of 0.25% RSUs (4-year vesting).
- Clawback: standard 12-month sign-on clawback applies (details to be included in offer).
